APPROVE
`BuildPlan`'s cognitive complexity now comes to about 6 (foreach, if, else-if and two `&&` sequences). Behaviour is preserved: `is var (eventIndex, documentIndex)` on the nullable tuple only matches when it is non-null, so it skips non-document Apply methods exactly as the old `continue` did. Nothing in the diff should fail to compile or raise a warning, though I reasoned from the diff alone and did not build it.
